main_text.p: Init. de jur. ordin. Quid enim si statutum ita disponeret, casu quo bannitus quis est ex causa pecuniariâ[?]? Foret id iniquum. Clar. §. Homicidium. n. 52.53.54. main_text.head: Disputatio Juridica, Ad l.2.Cod.leg Cornel. DE SICARIIS, SECUNDA.
main_text.p: Altera pars legis propositae erat adversus quem, cuique sit concessa, sui defensio? Et dicen-dum

page.notes: The woodcut initial is the letter A, joined to "ltera" as "Altera". "pecuniariâ" and "causâ" are read with a doubtful mark over the final vowel; the reading is uncertain. The citation lines are set in the text column, not in the margin, so they are main text in italics. The faint watermark at the lower right belongs to the digitiser and is left out.
